name: verify font-lock faces
comment: Fontify a fixture buffer and assert the faces structurally. Interactively, `elate -s N buffer demo.el --props` and `elate -s N faces-at LINE:COL --buffer demo.el` show the same facts.

steps.eval:
(with-current-buffer (get-buffer-create "demo.el") (erase-buffer) (emacs-lisp-mode) (insert "(defun demo-add (x)
  "Add one to X."
  (1+ x))
") (font-lock-ensure) t)
steps.comment: fixture: a fontified elisp buffer (never displayed -- font-lock-ensure still fontifies it)
the docstring wears a doc/string face
